title: Stud Wars
subtitle: Every LEGO® Star Wars™ set on sale right now, rated brick by brick
fan_line: An unofficial LEGO® Star Wars™ fan guide, made for one family. Not for sale.

Product images are © The LEGO Group and used with permission; review photos are © Brickset and used with permission; minifigure images come from Rebrickable.
version_note: Covers the 74 LEGO Star Wars sets that Brickset lists as on sale on 5 November 2026. Facts checked against Brickset's set database and reviews that day.
description: An unofficial fan guide to every LEGO Star Wars set on sale in November 2026: the story behind each set, pros and cons, ratings, hundreds of photos and plenty of new words.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. Some come from engineering, some from money and shops, some from films and some from science. A true Jedi of words can use three of them in one sentence. Try it.

chapters.title: Before You Build
chapters.toc: Ratings, prices and the small print
chapters.label: Start here
chapters.dek: Seventy-four sets, five bricks, one honest opinion each, and the story behind every set. Here's how to read the ratings, the prices and the pros and cons.

chapters.title: The Brick That Talks Back
chapters.dek: LEGO's biggest new idea in decades: a brick with a speaker, lights and sensors inside. Australia was one of only six countries to get it first. Is it any good?

chapters.title: This Is the Way
chapters.toc: Mando, Grogu and the movie sets
chapters.dek: A new film means a whole galaxy of new sets, from a tiny paper-bag Razor Crest to a 1,683-piece Sandcrawler.

chapters.title: Send in the Clones
chapters.kicker: The Clone Wars and Battle Packs
chapters.dek: Clone Troopers, Battle Droids, walkers and a very wobbly tank. Plus the big question: why do Battle Packs cost so much more than they used to?

chapters.title: Ships to Swoosh
chapters.dek: Sets built to be flown around the room at top speed, making engine noises with your mouth. (Everyone does it.)

chapters.title: Big Heads, Bigger Droids
chapters.dek: R2-D2, C-3PO, Chopper, K-2SO, BB-8, a giant Darth Vader and a Battle Droid on a flying scooter: the characters you build instead of the vehicles.

chapters.title: Shelf Stars
chapters.toc: Helmets, mini starships and the logo
chapters.dek: Models made for looking at, not playing with. Most say 18+ on the box, but that's about who they're for, not a rule.

chapters.title: The Dream Shelf
chapters.dek: The biggest, most detailed and most expensive LEGO Star Wars sets of all. This is a chapter for dreaming, not shopping.

chapters.title: The Festive Force
chapters.toc: The Advent Calendar and a gingerbread walker
chapters.dek: It's November, so the Christmas sets are here: an Advent Calendar and an AT-AT made of (LEGO) gingerbread.

chapters.title: The Stud Wars Awards
chapters.toc: Best sets, charts and a set-finder
chapters.dek: Best value, best minifigures, biggest, priciest and most disappointing, plus a flowchart to find the right set for you.

chapters.title: The Jedi Trials
chapters.label: Back of the book
chapters.dek: Eighteen questions. Get sixteen right and you're a Jedi Master of bricks.

chapters.title: The Word Holocron
chapters.toc: Every Word Watch word, A to Z
chapters.label: Back of the book
